run_fuse_gmock: run fuse_gmock_files.py to fuse Google Mock and Google Test source code into three installable files
run_fuse_gmock_with_root: run fuse_gmock_files.py with a custom GMOCK_ROOT_DIR and OUTPUT_DIR to generate fused gmock/gtest headers and source
fuse_gmock_headers: fuse all Google Mock header files recursively into a single gmock/gmock.h output file
fuse_gmock_gtest_all_cc: fuse gtest-all.cc and gmock-all.cc into a single gmock-gtest-all.cc source file
validate_gmock_root_dir: validate that the given gmock root directory contains the required gmock.h and gmock-all.cc seed files
